title: Taxonomy of the Occlupanida (parasitoids on bread bag tags)
summary: A scientific-style taxonomic classification and documentation of Occlupanida, small plastic parasitoid organisms that inhabit bread bag closure tags, presented with scholarly rigor and detailed morphological descriptions in a deliberately humorous academic format.
problem_solved: Provides formal scientific taxonomy and nomenclature for the whimsical phenomenon of small plastic fragments that collect on bread bag tags.
why_valuable: It demonstrates how internet communities apply rigorous scientific methodology to absurd everyday phenomena, creating both humor and a surprisingly thorough taxonomic record.
